items.title: Does the parent-beats-neighbour gap move with the excursion cut the way the level does?
items.note: X99 showed the level of size heredity is cut-bound by a factor of three and even reverses between inflows; X102 showed it is definition-bound. The specificity has only ever been measured at v > 0.20. If the gap is an excursion-set quantity it should move with the cut, and the honest statement about this medium would then carry its cut twice over. Needs runs at 0.15 and 0.25 because the component logs store 0.20 areas only (X99's route); a pilot on one world decides whether the saved fields can be re-thresholded instead — check that before claiming the 2 GPU-hours.
